key_insight: RASPER learns to summarize discharge notes in a way that preserves the details most useful for predicting clinical outcomes, rather than just producing generic summaries.
clinical_relevance: This could help EHR models use unstructured notes more effectively alongside structured codes for tasks like readmission prediction and medication recommendation.
method: Uses an LLM-based summarizer tuned for task-relevant evidence extraction
Trains the summarizer with reinforcement learning from downstream prediction feedback
Conditions note summarization on structured EHR codes via longitudinal soft prompts
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains over strong baselines on readmission prediction and medication recommendation using MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.
watch_item: Performance depends on downstream prediction feedback and integration into EHR workflows, so clinical utility may vary if the structured data are incomplete or the summarizer misses rare but important note details.
paper_title: RASPER: Reward-Aligned Summarization of Clinical Notes for EHR Outcome Prediction
